text: Caddywompus legs on one side.. Easy to put together, but it’s unstable. The legs are very caddywompus. Empty, it’s too difficult for one person to move once assembled. It’s too short for long dresses if you are over 5 ft tall. Sending it back.

product_metadata.title: SONGMICS Clothes Rack with Wheels, Heavy-Duty Garment Rack with Extendable Hanging Rod, 286.6 lb Load Capacity, Clothing Rack for Hanging Clothes, All Metal, Chrome-Plated, Silver UHSR11S
features: [Enhanced Load Capacity] Thanks to the 1 mm thick steel tubes, which are thicker and sturdier than normal 0.8 mm thick ones, and the heavy-duty PP casters, this clothes rack supports up to 286.6 lb. So feel free to hang your heavy coats on!

[Extendable Hanging Rod] Each end of the top rod extends an additional 7.9” to give you more hanging space (the top rod extends from 43.3" to 59.1"); the 2 extension ends are also ideal for hanging your handbags, hats, scarves, or other accessories on
[Easy to Move and Lock] Four 360° swivel casters, 2 of which have brakes, make it easy for you to move this clothing rack from your bedroom to your coatroom and lock it in place when needed

[Easy to Assemble and Disassemble] You can set up this clothes rack for hanging clothes in just 3 steps without any tools! When not in need, it’s easy to dismantle so you can store it in unused corners to save space

[Versatile Use] This garment rack can be used to hang clothes in your bedroom or living room or to dry clothes in your laundry room, and the space near the bottom bar is perfect for storing your shoes. The chrome-plated steel also allows for outdoor use
